name: Titan PVP · Arc Striker Duelist
notes:
The easiest Titan to win gunfights with. Thruster lets you peek and dodge back out, One-Eyed Mask gives you an overshield after every kill, and Knockout heals you after melee kills.
Stats: Health > Class > Weapons
Armor set: 4x Shrewd Survivor (Reflex Action, Hotshot)
Weapons:
- Primary: Ace of Spades
- Special: Matador 64 (Smallbore / Smoothbore, Accurized Rounds / Light Mag, Threat Detector, Opening Shot, Range)
- Heavy: The Hothead (Quick Launch, Impact Casing, Reconstruction, Bait and Switch, Velocity)
Hold an angle. Thruster around a corner, shoot first, and finish low-health players with Seismic Strike. Each kill on your marked target gives you an overshield, so push into the next fight while it's up. Don't chase the mark into a bad spot.

name: Titan PVP · Void Sentinel Anchor
notes:

- Heavy: Bad Omens (Quick Launch, Impact Casing, Tracking Module, Cluster Bomb, Blast Radius)

name: Titan PVP · Stasis Behemoth Auto Anchor
notes:
Built around automatic weapons. Run an auto rifle and an SMG together, and use Stasis walls and slows to keep fights at the ranges where they win. Glacier walls block sightlines so enemies have to come into your range, and frozen or slowed players can't strafe out of your sustained fire.
Stats: Health > Class > Weapons
Armor set: 4x Cruel Electrum (Primary Survivor, Primary Phantom)
Weapons:
- Kinetic: Khvostov 7G-0X
- Energy: The Hero's Burden (Smallbore, Accurized Rounds, Zen Moment / Moving Target, Kill Clip / Iron Reach, Range)
- Heavy: The Hothead (Quick Launch, Impact Casing, Reconstruction, Bait and Switch, Velocity)
The tradeoff: two primaries means no special ammo. You give up shotgun and sniper one-shots for weapons that win every mid- and close-range trade. Throw a Glacier Grenade to cut a lane, hold behind your Hoarfrost wall, and beam people with Khvostov as they come around it. Swap to Hero's Burden when someone rushes you. Howl of the Storm freezes rushers, and Whisper of Chains reduces your damage taken while you stand next to frozen targets. On controller, autos and SMGs get the most out of aim assist.
#spinz #titan #pvp

name: Titan PVE · Prismatic Stoicism: Arc Slam
notes:
The S-tier Titan for Master raids and GM Ops, built around Arc. You sprint-slam with Consecration, Synthoceps boosts the hit when you're surrounded, Knockout heals you on melee kills, and Inmost Light means every ability you use speeds up the other two. Thundercrash and Pulse Grenade keep the whole kit Arc so the Arc artifact perks and Arc Siphon mods stack on top.
Stats: Melee 150-200 > Grenade 100+ > Health 70+. Over 100, the extra Melee boosts melee damage, so keep pushing it.
Armor set: 4x CODA (Between Poles, So Very Thin)
Weapons:
- Energy · Primary: Voltaic Shade (Fluted Barrel, Overclocked Heatsink, Jolting Feedback / Trickle Charge, Meganeura / Voltshot, Cooling Efficiency)
- Kinetic · Special: Praxic Blade
- Heavy: Bitter End (Fluted Barrel, Light Heatsink, Attrition Orbs / Trickle Charge, Jolting Feedback / Killing Tally, Cooling Efficiency)
Run into a group, sprint and hit melee to Consecration slam (sweep, then the second slam), and get surrounded on purpose, because that's when Synthoceps and Facet of Protection both kick in. Every slam triggers Inmost Light, so your grenade and class ability come back faster. Throw Pulse at your feet, Thruster out, and get back into Consecration. Knockout heals you on every melee kill and Heavy Handed drops orbs. On bosses, pop Thundercrash, then swap to Praxic Blade.
#spinz #titan #pve
